name: calc_sum_sq_card_fixed_points_perm
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => σ i = i)).card ^ 2 = 2 * n.factorial
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => σ i = i)).card ^ 2 = 2 * n.factorial
informal: Second moment of fixed-point count: ∑_σ fix(σ)² = 2·n! for n ≥ 2 (variance 1) — count triples (σ,i,j) with both fixed: n·(n−1)! diagonal plus n(n−1)·(n−2)! off-diagonal; equivalently Burnside for the action on ordered pairs (2 orbits).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → ∑ σ, {i | σ i = i}.card ^ 2 = 2 * n.factorial
